CLM-MAT-0089.statement: In a 54-billion-atom RPV steel aging benchmark, AtomWorld-Mirror achieves an edit F1 score of 0.91 with zero physically invalid edit violations.

extra_quotes: We propose AtomWorld-Mirror, a time-aware macro-step world model for the critical evolution backbone of atomic systems.

For Step-Wise atomistic simulation, AtomWorld-Mirror distills short micro-event segments into physically reachable transitions between key states, jointly predicting sparse structural edits and accumulated physical time through latent macro-step dynamics.
AtomWorld-Mirror targets long-horizon materials evolution in regimes where explicit microscopic replay consumes most of the computational budget before structurally consequential states are reached.

The current operating range reaches k= 1024 . Extending candidate-support construction and conservation projection to systems with larger species inventories, together with topology criteria for continuously evolving structures, defines the next methodological step.
